title: JavaScript Fundamentals
tagline: Learn to program from zero by building a real expense tracker in the browser.
description: You have never written a line of code, and you want to understand what the computer is actually doing when it runs one. This course starts at the very beginning, with values, variables and the console, and explains each idea by showing what JavaScript does with it, step by step, before asking you to use it.

Every lesson adds a piece to Pocket, an expense tracker that begins as a short script and ends as a small browser app with a form, a filterable list, running totals and saved data. Almost every lesson ends with an exercise you solve in the browser and check instantly, so you write real code every evening.
audience: Career switchers and complete beginners who have never programmed and want a solid, honest foundation in JavaScript.
prerequisites: None. You need a computer with a modern browser; knowing a little HTML helps in section 4.
learnItems: Read and write JavaScript values, variables, conditions and loops
Write functions and understand scope and closures
Transform lists of data with map, filter, reduce and sort
Build interactive pages with the DOM, events and forms
Handle asynchronous code with promises, async/await and fetch
Organise a small app with modules and classes, and debug it

lessons.l-js-1-1: What JavaScript Is and Where It Runs
lessons.l-js-2-1: Making Decisions: if, else and Truthiness
lessons.l-js-3-3: Summing and Sorting: reduce and sort
lessons.l-js-4-5: Async JavaScript: Promises, async/await and fetch
